WHAT.TITLE: What should I send by DM?
WHAT.TEXT: Write the message people get. It can have a link, catalog, coupon or price.
WHAT.PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: Hi! Here is the catalog with prices: studioacme.com/catalog. Use the coupon POST10 for 10% off.
WHAT.TOO_LONG: The message is too long for Meta. Make it a bit shorter.
WHAT.ALL_IN_ONE: Put everything in this message: the next one only goes out if the person replies.

WHO.TITLE: Who gets it?
WHO.TEXT: I read each comment and send it only when it fits. Tap one or write it your way.
WHO.PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: people who ask for the link or the price
